text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after the Unity Cup and the Twinkle Series have both wrapped up, Director Akikawa summons our team.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Well done on getting through all the ups and downs life has thrown at you!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And more importantly, well done on your magnificent performance in the Unity Cup!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it is unfortunate that you could not seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However, your teamwork was impeccable, and your trainer believed in you right to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I think the earnest feelings you hold in your hearts really helped save a certain other team and their trainer!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Allow me to congratulate you on your hard work. Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh? We saved a team? I don't remember doin' anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Welp! All's well that ends well! Right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Training as a team was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Agreed! I feel like my luck was boosted just by being with you all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I feel the same. I'm so glad I joined.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Very good! It brings me much bliss to hear you enjoyed yourselves. I'll be looking forward to your future performance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I make a promise with <chrname> to work hard and live up to Director Akikawa's expectations.
